boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 147 is the longest solve in the 101–150 range — a dual-chamber column shifter with a tall left `1` vault and a separate right `13` pocket. Bottom launcher pieces feed the upper grid through narrow lanes. The yellow-outlined blue column on the left must stay standing until the purple `2` tile and horizontal red bar clear the center, or the vault's feed lane collapses.
landmarks: Block Out Level 147 is the longest solve in the 101–150 range — a dual-chamber column shifter with a tall left `1` vault and a separate right `13` pocket.
Bottom launcher pieces feed the upper grid through narrow lanes.
The yellow-outlined blue column on the left must stay standing until the purple `2` tile and horizontal red bar clear the center, or the vault's feed lane collapses.

quickTips: Break the 12 highlight before moving the bottom blue-base launcher.
Keep the 13 pocket sealed until the left 1 chamber accepts its first feed.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Slide the bottom yellow L-piece left on its cyan base to start opening the left 1 chamber without shifting the 13 pocket.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Feed the orange/blue/yellow/red floor cluster upward through the bottom left arrow once the left chamber accepts pieces.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Break the orange-bordered 12 highlight square in the right chamber after the left column thins.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the yellow-outlined blue vertical column on the left once the 12 tile is gone.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Match the purple 2 tile (orange border) with the yellow 3 scrap above the green arrow block.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Spend the bottom yellow launcher pieces — L on pink base, then 2×2 on blue base — through the center red bar.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Route the last scraps through the green up-arrow exit for the PERFECT clear.

failurePoints: Launching the blue-base yellow 2×2 before the 12 highlight breaks, sealing the green up-arrow lane.
Opening the 13 pocket before the left 1 chamber thins, flooding the center red bar.
